column3: The idle task is created with the starting session and watches starting as well as running; a close of a session with no committed id replays the generation's :create key to learn it and deletes that machine
column4: A crash between the create answer and the commit leaves starting with no id; Instabox answers the same create key with the same machine for 7 days, so the replay finds it without a machine index, and a create that never reached Instabox is created and deleted at once (about 5 s, $0.00002)
column5: browser.test.ts: replays the create key to delete a machine whose id was never committed (create, create replay, delete; no machine left)
